devices.name: Nwave - Smart Parking Sensor
devices.description: The Nwave Smart Parking Sensor is equipped with a magnetometer, temperature, and proximity sensors for parking detection. The smart parking sensors installed in each parking spot generate data on space occupancy in real-time and is transmitted over a LoRaWAN network.

devices.name: Nwave - Smart Parking Sensor G4 FM
devices.description: The wireless vehicle detection sensor with high detection accuracy 99.7%, fast detection 3-5 seconds, low profile - 20mm, 10 years battery life @20 parking sessions a day, vehicle counting capabilities.
